The Issue was then closed, but its own closing comment names what is left: the area picker, the not-covered panel and the waitlist step still say metro (allow-listed in the guard), and the area search, `/api/boundaries` and neighbourhood search still read `msa_code`. The zip step itself is now reached only through the profile screen, which the live sign-in skips since #946 (F081.1, #847).
